outfits.name: Base (swimwear)
outfits.prompt: A young Black woman in her early twenties with a toned, athletic swimmer's build and deep brown skin with a warm, even complexion. She wears long box braids falling past her shoulders, currently loose. Her eyes are dark brown with a faint amber ring, sharp and alert. Her face is structured with high cheekbones and a strong jawline. She is dressed in a sporty black one-piece swimsuit with thick athletic straps and a high-cut leg, worn under an unzipped oversized denim jacket with the sleeves pushed up past her elbows. Thin gold hoop earrings sit in each ear. She is barefoot. She stands with her weight on one leg in a relaxed contrapposto, arms loosely at her sides, chin slightly tilted up with a confident, faintly amused smirk paired with those sharp, sizing-up eyes.

outfits.name: House Party
outfits.prompt: A young Black woman in her early twenties with a toned, athletic swimmer's build and deep brown skin with a warm, even complexion. She wears long box braids falling past her shoulders, loose and swaying slightly. Her eyes are dark brown with a faint amber ring around the iris. She has high cheekbones and a strong jawline. She is dressed in black high-waisted jeans with a straight, relaxed leg, a fitted rust-coloured cropped cotton tank top that bares a sliver of midriff, and a faded blue denim jacket draped loosely over her shoulders rather than worn on her arms. On her feet are chunky white lace-up sneakers. She wears thin gold hoop earrings in each ear and several thin gold bangles stacked on her left wrist. She stands with her weight on her right leg in a relaxed contrapposto, her left hand resting on her hip with fingers tucked into the waistband of her jeans, her right shoulder slightly forward where the jacket sits, head tilted just a degree to the side as she looks squarely at the viewer.

outfits.name: Graduation Party
outfits.prompt: A young Black woman in her early twenties with deep brown skin and a warm, even complexion, toned athletic build with real strength in the shoulders and legs. Her hair is worn in long box braids falling past her shoulders, currently loose. Her eyes are dark brown with a faint amber ring around the iris, set beneath high cheekbones and a strong jawline. She wears a sleeveless terracotta midi dress with a straight neckline and a modest slit along the left leg, cut clean in a simple silhouette with a slightly worn-in look. On her feet are white low-top canvas sneakers with thin rubber soles, laced loosely. Thin gold hoop earrings sit in each earlobe, a delicate gold chain necklace rests against her collarbone, and a single thin gold bangle circles her left wrist. She stands with her weight on her right leg in relaxed contrapposto, her left hand resting on her hip with the thumb hooked into the side seam of the dress, her right arm hanging loose at her side, chin tilted slightly down as she looks squarely at the viewer with a confident, faintly amused smirk.
